explanation.tr:
• Sıfat (adjective) ismi niteler: a careful driver, The soup is hot.
• Zarf (adverb) fiili, sıfatı veya başka zarfı niteler: He drives carefully. It's extremely hot.
• Çoğu zarf: sıfat + -ly → quick → quickly, happy → happily, terrible → terribly
• Düzensiz: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard (hardly = neredeyse hiç!), late → late (lately = son zamanlarda)
• Bağlama fiillerinden sonra sıfat: be, look, seem, feel, smell, taste, sound → She looks happy. It tastes good.
• Karşılaştırma: tall → taller → the tallest; beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful; good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst
• Zarflarda: carefully → more carefully; well → better
explanation.tk:
• Sypat (adjective) ady häsiýetlendirýär: a careful driver, The soup is hot.
• Hal (adverb) işligi, sypaty ýa-da başga haly häsiýetlendirýär: He drives carefully. It's extremely hot.
• Köp hallar: sypat + -ly → quick → quickly, happy → happily, terrible → terribly
• Nädogry: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard (hardly = has hiç diýen ýaly!), late → late (lately = soňky wagtlar)
• Baglaýjy işliklerden soň sypat: be, look, seem, feel, smell, taste, sound → She looks happy. It tastes good.
• Deňeşdirme: tall → taller → the tallest; beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful; good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst
• Hallarda: carefully → more carefully; well → better
explanation.ru:
• Прилагательное описывает существительное: a careful driver, The soup is hot.
• Наречие описывает глагол, прилагательное или другое наречие: He drives carefully. It's extremely hot.
• Большинство наречий: прилагательное + -ly → quick → quickly, happy → happily, terrible → terribly
• Исключения: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard (hardly = едва ли!), late → late (lately = в последнее время)
• После глаголов-связок — прилагательное: be, look, seem, feel, smell, taste, sound → She looks happy. It tastes good.
• Степени сравнения: tall → taller → the tallest; beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful; good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst
• У наречий: carefully → more carefully; well → better

title: Articles a/an, the, zero: B1 Review

explanation.tr:
• a / an: tekil, sayılabilen, ilk kez söz edilen veya 'herhangi bir' → a book, an apple, an hour (h okunmaz), a university (/ju/ sesi)
• the: bilinen, daha önce söz edilen, tek olan → I bought a book. The book is great. The sun, the Moon, the Internet
• the ile: nehirler, denizler, sıradağlar, çoğul ülkeler: the Nile, the Caspian Sea, the Alps, the USA, the Netherlands
• the yok (zero article): genel çoğul/sayılamayan isimler (I like cats. Water is important.), çoğu ülke/şehir (Turkmenistan, Ashgabat), öğünler (have breakfast), diller, sporlar
• Kalıplar: go to school/bed/work (amaç), by bus, at home; ama the cinema, the theatre
explanation.tk:
• a / an: birlikdäki, sanalýan, ilkinji gezek agzalýan ýa-da 'islendik' → a book, an apple, an hour (h okalmaýar), a university (/ju/ sesi)
• the: belli, öň agzalan, ýeke-täk → I bought a book. The book is great. The sun, the Moon, the Internet
• the bilen: derýalar, deňizler, dag gerşleri, köplük görnüşli ýurtlar: the Nile, the Caspian Sea, the Alps, the USA, the Netherlands
• the ýok (zero article): umumy köplük/sanalmaýan atlar (I like cats. Water is important.), köp ýurtlar/şäherler (Turkmenistan, Ashgabat), nahar wagtlary (have breakfast), diller, sport görnüşleri
• Aňlatmalar: go to school/bed/work (maksat), by bus, at home; emma the cinema, the theatre
explanation.ru:
• a / an: ед. ч., исчисляемое, упоминается впервые или «какой-нибудь» → a book, an apple, an hour (h не читается), a university (звук /ju/)
• the: известное, уже упомянутое, единственное → I bought a book. The book is great. The sun, the Moon, the Internet
• the с: реками, морями, горными цепями, странами во мн. ч.: the Nile, the Caspian Sea, the Alps, the USA, the Netherlands
• Без артикля: общие мн. ч./неисчисляемые (I like cats. Water is important.), большинство стран/городов (Turkmenistan, Ashgabat), приёмы пищи (have breakfast), языки, виды спорта
• Устойчивые: go to school/bed/work (по назначению), by bus, at home; но the cinema, the theatre

explanation.tr:
Koşul cümlelerinin dört tipi:
• Tip 0 (genel gerçek): If + present, present → If you heat ice, it melts.
• Tip 1 (gerçek gelecek): If + present, will → If it rains, I'll stay home.
• Tip 2 (hayali şimdi/gelecek): If + past, would → If I had wings, I would fly.
• Tip 3 (hayali geçmiş): If + had V3, would have V3 → If I had studied, I would have passed.
unless = if not: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
if kısmında will/would kullanılmaz.
explanation.tk:
Şert sözlemleriniň dört görnüşi:
• 0-njy görnüş (umumy hakykat): If + present, present → If you heat ice, it melts.
• 1-nji görnüş (hakyky geljek): If + present, will → If it rains, I'll stay home.
• 2-nji görnüş (hyýaly häzir/geljek): If + past, would → If I had wings, I would fly.
• 3-nji görnüş (hyýaly geçmiş): If + had V3, would have V3 → If I had studied, I would have passed.
unless = if not: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
if böleginde will/would ulanylmaýar.
explanation.ru:
Четыре типа условных предложений:
• Тип 0 (общая истина): If + present, present → If you heat ice, it melts.
• Тип 1 (реальное будущее): If + present, will → If it rains, I'll stay home.
• Тип 2 (нереальное настоящее/будущее): If + past, would → If I had wings, I would fly.
• Тип 3 (нереальное прошлое): If + had V3, would have V3 → If I had studied, I would have passed.
unless = if not: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
В части с if не используется will/would.
